tagline.en: Allen Institute for AI's WildDet3D — a 3D object detector for in-the-wild scenes and open-world perception.
tagline.zh: 艾伦人工智能研究院(AI2)的 WildDet3D——面向真实野外场景与开放世界感知的三维物体检测器。

en: WildDet3D is a 3D detection model from the Allen Institute for AI (AI2). It targets 3D object detection in unconstrained, in-the-wild scenes, aiming to perceive object geometry and position beyond the narrow, curated settings that many 3D detectors assume.
It is distributed as upstream source with detector weights; the checkpoint on Hugging Face carries a SAM-derived license, which you should review before use.

In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its config and inference route; the detector assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs before running detection.
zh: WildDet3D 是艾伦人工智能研究院(AI2)推出的三维检测模型。它面向无约束的真实野外场景做三维物体检测,力求在许多三维检测器所假设的狭窄、精挑场景之外,感知物体的几何与位置。
它以上游源码加检测器权重形式发布;Hugging Face 上的 checkpoint 采用源自 SAM 的许可,使用前请先审阅。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册,你可以解析它的配置与推理路径;检测器素材需另行准备,运行时会在检测前列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Use WildDet3D when you need 3D object detection for diverse, real-world scenes rather than a single curated benchmark domain.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在多样的真实场景中做三维物体检测,而非局限于单一精挑基准域时,适合使用 WildDet3D。

notFor.en: It is a perception model, not a generative one; it needs its detector assets staged, and its checkpoint carries a SAM-derived license to review.
notFor.zh: 它是感知模型而非生成模型;需要准备好检测器素材,且其 checkpoint 采用源自 SAM 的许可,需要审阅。
